what_failed: book-cert overnight loop batch d14 HUNG ~6h on a server rate-limit; ate the 8h budget; stopped at 53/100
root_cause: no stall-stop watchdog on a silent-hanging batch
fix: 45-min no-growth -> TaskStop + STALLED_RETRY + drop concurrency; sequential under os_cost_guard
lesson: a batch can hang silently for hours; a watchdog must stop it

what_failed: laptop crash wiped /tmp wave text mid-wave; new terminal risked restarting the whole wave
root_cause: working text in volatile /tmp; no durable rebuild path
fix: durable reextract script + slug->source map in control/; bank-after-every-batch; resume never restart
lesson: never keep critical work-text only in /tmp; controller files are the durable state

what_failed: docs-tooling verifier reported its OWN spot-check scope as 'sampled', tripping the whole-read gate and holding 12 valid docs
root_cause: verify prompt conflated verifier sampling with reader coverage
fix: verifier must judge whether the READER whole-read, not how many files it personally re-opened; rerun failed-only
lesson: write verify prompts to judge the worker, not the verifier's own method
